title: Spelling Warriors
description: A spelling activity for grades 2–6. Follow these simple steps to use it with your class.
steps: Open Spelling Warriors and look at the start or setup screen.
Find the edit, settings, word-entry, or question-entry controls, if offered, and prepare your spelling words and answers.
If there are answer choices, select or check the correct answer. If there are pictures, make sure they match the words.
Use any Update, Apply, or Save Changes button shown to place your edits into the game.
Check the word order, placement, and readability BEFORE pressing Start.
Choose the available mode, team, timer, and audio settings.
Start the activity and follow the on-screen prompts.

buttons.name: Edit / Settings / Customize
buttons.meaning: Open the setup area to change words, questions, choices, or game options, if shown.

buttons.name: Add / +
buttons.meaning: Add another word or question in games that provide this control.

buttons.name: Update / Apply / Save Changes
buttons.meaning: Apply your edits to the current game board before starting, if this button appears.

buttons.name: Start / Play
buttons.meaning: Begin the activity after checking your setup.

buttons.name: Reset / Restart
buttons.meaning: Restart the current activity; check whether it also clears scores or changes.

buttons.name: Fullscreen / ⛶
buttons.meaning: Expand the game to fill the screen.

buttons.name: Export JSON / Export Data
buttons.meaning: Download your edited content as a .json backup, when this option is provided.

buttons.name: Load JSON / Import JSON / Load Data
buttons.meaning: Choose a previously exported .json file to restore game content, when supported.

sections.heading: 💾 How to export, import, or load your game data
steps: Finish editing the words, questions, answers, or pictures first.
Look in the game’s setup, editor, or settings for Export JSON / Export Data / Save File. If you see one, click it to download your work as a .json file.
Keep the downloaded file in a safe place, such as a folder named after the class. Export again after making new changes.
To use the same content later, open this SAME game and choose Import JSON / Load JSON / Load Data (whichever appears).
Select the .json file you exported from this game. Check the imported words, question order, and pictures before pressing Start.
Do not use a guide JSON file from the website’s guides folder as a game-data file. They serve different purposes.

tips: The instruction JSON file in the website guides folder is NOT the same as the game-data JSON file you export.
A browser may remember changes on one device, but do not rely on that as your only backup. Export after editing whenever the game offers it.
Button labels and available editing features can differ between games. If your game does not show an export/import button, that feature has not been confirmed for that game.
